- $$number_{of,W}$$: The number of words where an uppercase W is surrounded by $$1$$ or more adjacent uppercase letters on each side (e.g., UWU, OWNed, SHOWDOWN) in comments.
- $$mean_Q$$: The average of two critics' ratings for each row.
